name: ds michael furniture
old_description: Amazing in every way. Great guys to produce luxury furniture at a reasonable price. Found them through a friend of a friend introduced me. Would check them out if you're looking for higher end pieces or collections.
about:
DS Michael Furniture operates from Phoenix, Arizona, specializing in luxury furnishings for the hospitality industry. The company does not disclose its founding date or ownership details, but client testimonials reference a principal named David who has overseen facility expansions and product improvements over multiple years.

The manufacturer produces custom furniture, cabinetry, contract upholstery, case goods, and wall‑bed systems such as the Academy Wall Bed (horizontal) and the Academy Wall Bed with Sofa (vertical queen). It serves projects requiring tailored seating, tables, booths, and built‑in sleeping solutions, though specific facility dimensions, employee counts, and production volumes are not provided.

Past work includes installations at Hotel Valley Ho, the Ritz‑Carlton Laguna, the restaurant Fat Ox, and Momotaro Chicago, as well as furnishings for Airbnb hosts. The company focuses on the hospitality sector, delivering pieces that meet commercial durability and design standards.
